reader.requirement: At --std 85 every entry that defines a printable item (an elementary entry with a COLUMN NUMBER clause, XIII.3.11.1 / XIII.3.11.3 SR1) must be refused unless it contains a LINE NUMBER clause itself or is subordinate (by level-number ancestry, not by position) to an entry that contains one; entries without COLUMN are not printable and are not asked.

edition-consulted.switches: refuses at 85 (COBOL0900, ReportMultiColumn2002) the 2002 COLUMN forms: several operands, a PLUS operand, LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT, the COL/COLS/COLUMNS/NUMBERS spellings, leaving exactly COLUMN NUMBER IS integer-1
Edition.DialectLevel < 2002 arms for OTHER rules of the same screen (the XIII.3.9.3 SR11 Table 1 rows, the format 2/3 level rules); the LINE-ancestry arm itself is unconditional

reader.edition-search: grep of ScreenReportEntryClausePresence for DialectLevel/Version/Construct: the test `elementary && column && !line && !SubordinateToLineClause` has no edition condition; SubordinateToLineClause has none.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the LINE-ancestry requirement is the same at 85 and 2023; what differs is the COLUMN clause's own form (85 admits only COLUMN NUMBER IS integer-1), gated by VersionConformancePass.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witnesses cover a COLUMN entry with no LINE anywhere, a COLUMN sibling of a LINE entry, and the legal 01/03 LINE/05 COLUMN and LINE+COLUMN-in-one-entry forms; not exercised: LINE on the 01 with COLUMN two levels below through a LINE-less group, a COLUMN under a LINE-less group that is a sibling of a LINE entry, a non-printable entry without LINE, the 2002 COLUMN forms at 85.

The diagnostic cites only the 2023 clause numbers, not §1985:XIII.3.15.3 SR8 (cosmetic).
